source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Colombia 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.quote: Adidas has revealed the Colombia national team Home kit for 2026, continuing its partnership with the Federación Colombiana de Fútbol
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: 'The crest of the Colombian Football Federation appears on the chest beside the adidas logo in blue, with "Colombia" printed on the back of the collar', and the full kit is 'completed with blue shorts, red and yellow detailing, and red socks'. The launch photos show the shirt front, sleeves, back collar and shorts: no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's 2026 home kit (yellow with butterfly-inspired motifs drawn from magical realism) carries only the FCF crest and the adidas logo in blue on the chest and 'Colombia' on the back of the collar; the launch description and photos show plain sleeves and blue shorts with red socks (Football Shirt Culture's launch description and images).
